samples_reviewed.question_text: Look at the data: cats: 1, dogs: 3, birds: 2, fish: 2. Draw one 🐾 for each item in the picture graph.
Complete the picture graph for apples: 3, bananas: 2, mangoes: 4, grapes: 3. Draw one 🍎 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: roses: 5, sunflowers: 5, tulips: 1, daisies: 2. Draw one 🌸 for each item.
Make a picture graph to show: Monday: 4, Tuesday: 4, Wednesday: 3, Thursday: 1. Draw one 📖 for each item.
Look at the data: cats: 4, dogs: 1, birds: 5, fish: 5. Draw one 🐾 for each item in the picture graph.
Complete the picture graph for Grade 1: 5, Grade 2: 5, Grade 3: 4, Grade 4: 3. Draw one ⭐ for each item.
The survey shows: Monday: 3, Tuesday: 2, Wednesday: 3, Thursday: 3. Make a picture graph by drawing one 📖 for each item.
Look at the data: basketball: 2, volleyball: 3, swimming: 2, running: 4. Draw one ⚽ for each item in the picture graph.
Look at the data: Monday: 3, Tuesday: 4, Wednesday: 2, Thursday: 5. Draw one 📖 for each item in the picture graph.
Make a picture graph to show: Math: 5, Science: 5, English: 1, Art: 1. Draw one 📚 for each item.

competency_fulfillment.rationale: Each render hands over a category-count list and asks for one drawn symbol per item, which is precisely presentation in a pictograph carrying no scale.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Four categories appear every time with counts spanning one through five, and ties between categories occur, so the presentation task is exercised across the whole span a scaleless graph can hold.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: One picture per unit removes any scale reading or multiplication, and the chosen symbols (paw, apple, flower, book, star) come from a first grader's own world.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: All ten renders are the same fill-in exercise. The opening rotates between three wordings, yet the pupil's action never changes, and nothing ever asks which of several already-drawn graphs matches the data - the recognition direction of presenting.

competency_alignment.rationale: Between seeds only the theme and the particular counts move. Nothing stretches graph-building itself: no fifth category, no zero-count row, no row that overflows the drawing space.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Counts of one to five keep every row drawable symbol by symbol, which is the right ceiling when no scale is available to compress a tall row.
